title: Introduction to Partial Differential Equations
description: Partial differential equations in physics (wave, heat and Laplace equations), solution by separation of variables, method of characteristics for first-order partial differential equations, boundary value problems, orthogonal functions, Fourier series, transform methods (Laplace and Fourier transforms), numerical methods.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MATH 346, MATH 323B, MATH 326.
